mapper.sql: U."USER_ID", U."LOGIN_ID", U."DISPLAY_NAME", U."EMAIL", U."STATUS" , U."CREATED_AT", U."UPDATED_AT", U."VERSION", C."PASSWORD_HASH"
mapper.select: SELECT U."USER_ID", U."LOGIN_ID", U."DISPLAY_NAME", U."EMAIL", U."STATUS" , U."CREATED_AT", U."UPDATED_AT", U."VERSION", NULL::varchar AS "PASSWORD_HASH" FROM "APP_USER" U ORDER BY U."DISPLAY_NAME" ASC, U."DISPLAY_NAME" DESC, U."USER_ID" ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT UD."USER_ID", D."DEPARTMENT_ID"::text AS "DEPARTMENT_ID", D."DEPARTMENT_NAME" , UD."IS_PRIMARY" AS "PRIMARY" FROM "USER_DEPARTMENT" UD JOIN "DEPARTMENT" D ON D."DEPARTMENT_ID" = UD."DEPARTMENT_ID" WHERE UD."USER_ID" IN #{id} ORDER BY UD."USER_ID", D."DEPARTMENT_ID"
SELECT R."ROLE_CODE" FROM "USER_ROLE" UR JOIN "APP_ROLE" R ON R."ROLE_ID" = UR."ROLE_ID" WHERE UR."USER_ID" = #{userId} AND R."ACTIVE" ORDER BY R."ROLE_CODE"

SELECT DISTINCT P."PERMISSION_CODE" FROM "USER_ROLE" UR JOIN "APP_ROLE" R ON R."ROLE_ID" = UR."ROLE_ID" AND R."ACTIVE" JOIN "ROLE_PERMISSION" RP ON RP."ROLE_ID" = R."ROLE_ID" JOIN "APP_PERMISSION" P ON P."PERMISSION_ID" = RP."PERMISSION_ID" WHERE UR."USER_ID" = #{userId} ORDER BY P."PERMISSION_CODE"
SELECT "ROLE_ID" FROM "APP_ROLE" WHERE "ROLE_ID" = #{roleId} AND "ACTIVE" FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "USER_ROLE" ("USER_ID", "ROLE_ID", "CREATED_AT", "CREATED_BY") VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{now}, #{actor,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
